decisions.reason: As a reusable harvesting crate tied to the firm's sustainability push and agriculture customers, it still fits strategy, though its narrow crop focus and lower recent visibility raise some rationalization risk.
A stackable plastic crate line is a core reusable packaging product for this firm, so it would usually be retained unless demand has proved clearly disappointing.
The medium-duty rackable pallet line supports the firm's central pallet portfolio, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
This plastic pallet with load retainers appears to be a narrower variant rather than a core platform, so the firm would likely redeploy resources to stronger pallet lines or new development.
